subject.title: fix: harden subprocess, maintenance, and output paths

question: Should this maintainer-takeover branch keep the `CHANGELOG.md` entries, or should release-note context stay in the PR body and final commit message?
rationale: Repository policy reserves `CHANGELOG.md` for release generation, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not choose a release-policy exception.

options.title: Remove changelog edits
options.body: Land the reliability fixes with release-note context preserved in the PR body or final commit message instead of `CHANGELOG.md`.

options.title: Keep by release exception
options.body: A release owner can intentionally keep these changelog entries in this PR before merge.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Leave the PR open until maintainers decide whether to land this batch or split it further.

recommendation.title: Remove changelog edits
recommendation.body: Land the reliability fixes with release-note context preserved in the PR body or final commit message instead of `CHANGELOG.md`.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the takeover branch and posted the current validation context, making him the best available owner for the changelog and landing-shape decision.
